name: Coca-Cola Fizz
description: Coca-Cola themed animated watchface: Spencerian logo, dynamic ribbon, bottle-cap temperature and rising soda fizz on classic Coke red.

steps.script: project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gClock = 'Clock'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ['Hour','Colon','Minute']) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gClock'; n++ } } return n

const out = {}; for (const nm of ['Hour','Minute','Colon','Temperature','Tagline']) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); out[nm] = e && [e.x, e.y, e.w, e.h, e.alignH, e.glyph && e.glyph.size]; } return out
